description: Edit the timeline of your Editor project (or one shared with you) the way a person does with the mouse, in one call: place a clip at a time on a track, trim either edge, split, move, delete, ripple delete, duplicate, link or unlink picture and sound, set speed, volume and fades, add or reorder tracks, put words on the picture (text layers), captions on the spoken words, a logo or picture over the frame, a motion block, transitions, keyframes, a clip's scale, position, rotation, opacity, fit, label and enable, and the colour look from the Design pane with its curves, wheels, film stock and mask. Pass operations in order; they run one after another with the Editor's own rules (picture clips never overlap on a track, every video clip keeps a linked sound clip under it, a trim never reaches past the file). The change is saved on the project, lands in its History, shows in the open Editor within seconds and can be undone there. Answers with a readback of the whole timeline. Stops at the first operation that cannot be done and saves nothing from that call. Spends no tokens.

label.description: A short name for this change as it will read in the project's History (for example "Place the 25 stops").

operations.description: The edits, in order. Each one is an object with op and the fields that op needs.

at_clip_sec.description: keyframe: the time inside the clip (seconds from its start) to pin scale, x, y, rotation, opacity at.

at_sec.description: place: where on the timeline the clip starts. split: where to cut.

at_secs.description: split_scenes: timeline seconds to cut the clip at (find_editor_scenes gives seconds in the file; add the clip's start).

background.description: text: { on, color, opacity, radius } a box behind the words.

block_id.description: motion: the motion block id (read_editor_timeline lists motionBlocks).

captions.description: caption: the spoken words with their times, one entry per caption.

color.description: text: the colour as #rrggbb. marker_add / marker_edit: teal, purple, rose, peach, orange or white.

db.description: volume: -60 to +24 dB, 0 is as recorded.

duration_sec.description: place: how many seconds of the file to use from source_in_sec (default: the whole file).

enabled.description: clip_settings: false disables the clip (it stays on the track, skipped in play and export).

end_sec.description: trim: the new end on the timeline.

fade_in_sec.description: fades: seconds of fade at the start.

fade_out_sec.description: fades: seconds of fade at the end.

film_stock.description: look: a film stock from the Design pane (K-400, Portra 160, Superia 400, Ektar 100, Cinestill 800T, Tri-X 400, HP5, VHS, Super 8, Polaroid 600, Bleach Bypass, None).

filters.description: look / clip_look: colour controls to set, e.g. { exposure: 10, contrast: 8, temp: -5 }; null resets one. Controls: exposure, contrast, highlight, shadow, whites, blacks, temp, tint, saturate, vibrance, brilliance, sharpen, clarity, blur, fade, vignette, grain, halation.

fit.description: clip_settings: contain = fit to frame, cover = fill frame.

font.description: text: the font, as the Text pane names it.

hidden.description: lane_settings: hide the track (on an audio track this mutes it).

image_url.description: logo: an https link to a PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF; Switch keeps its own copy in the project (or pass media_name of a picture in the project).

index.description: Which clip on that track, counting from 0 in play order (read_editor_timeline shows the index of every clip).

kind.description: lane_add: which kind of track. lane_delete: remove a track and its clips (not V1, not the text track). snapshot: save a restorable snapshot of the whole project (name). snapshot_restore / revision_restore: put the project back as a snapshot or a History revision had it. comment: a note in the Comments pane (text, optionally lane + index or at_sec). comment_resolve: mark it resolved. marker_add: a marker on the ruler (at_sec, text, color teal / purple / rose / peach / orange / white). marker_edit / marker_delete: move, relabel or remove one (marker_id). freeze: hold the clip's first frame for its whole length. reverse: play the clip backwards, picture and sound. fades on a video clip: the picture fades in and out (its sound follows through its linked sound clip). clip_look: colour on ONE clip (lane, index, filters as in look, or reset). lane_settings solo on an audio track: only solo tracks play and export. split_scenes: cut one clip at many seconds at once (lane, index, at_secs). auto_clip: the AI clipper's step, pieces of a media item (segments) laid in a row on V1 from at_sec or the end.

lane.description: The track the clip is on, as the Editor names it: V1, X2 (a video track above V1), A1, A2, T1, M1, G1.

locked.description: lane_settings: lock the track against edits.

marker_id.description: marker_edit / marker_delete: the marker id (read_editor_timeline lists markers).

mask.description: look: the Design pane mask { enabled, shape (split, filmstrip, circle, rectangle), x, y, width, height, rotation, feather }.

media_id.description: place: the media item id (get_editor_project lists the project media with ids).

media_name.description: place: or the media item by its name, when the id is not known.

name.description: lane_add / lane_settings: the track's name as it reads on screen.

on.description: freeze / reverse: true (default) turns it on, false turns it off.

op.description: What to do. place: a media item of the project onto a track at a time. trim: new start_sec and/or end_sec for a clip (the cut moves in the file; it cannot reach past the file). split: cut a clip at at_sec (its sound clip splits too). move: a clip to to_sec (and to_lane of the same kind). delete / ripple_delete: remove a clip (ripple closes the gap). duplicate: a copy right after the clip. link / unlink: a picture clip and a sound clip that move together. speed (rate), volume (db), fades (fade_in_sec, fade_out_sec). lane_add (kind), lane_reorder (lane, to_index), lane_settings (lane, name, hidden, locked). text: words on the picture from at_sec for duration_sec, with font, size, color, x, y, align, preset, background, stroke, shadow (a pink chip on T1). text_edit / text_delete by text_id. caption: captions on the spoken words (captions list, template, position). logo: a picture over the frame on G1 (image_url, an https PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF that Switch copies into the project, or media_name; at_sec, duration_sec, x, y, scale, opacity). motion: a motion block on M1 (block_id, at_sec, duration_sec). look: the Design pane colour controls (filters, including curves curveLuma/curveR/curveG/curveB and the wheels wheelShadHue/Sat, wheelMidHue/Sat, wheelTintHue/Sat, wheelOffHue/Sat, wheelIntensity), a film stock (film_stock, intensity), a mask, or reset. transition: the outgoing transition of a clip (transition, duration_sec). keyframe: pin scale, x, y, rotation, opacity at at_clip_sec; keyframes_clear removes them. clip_settings: scale, x, y, rotation, opacity, fit, enabled, name, tag on a clip.

preset.description: text: a style preset from the Text pane.

reset.description: look: true clears every colour value and the film stock. clip_look: true clears the clip's own colour.

resolved.description: comment_resolve: false reopens the comment (default true).

scale.description: logo: size, 1 to 200 (default 74). clip_settings: 0 to 300 (on a second-track video, 100 = a third of the frame wide).

segments.description: auto_clip: pieces of the file (seconds in the file) to lay in a row on V1.

shadow.description: text: { on, color } a drop shadow.

side.description: revision_restore: restore the project as it was before the revision (default) or after it.

snapshot_id.description: snapshot_restore: the snapshot id (read_editor_timeline lists history.snapshots).

solo.description: lane_settings on an audio track: true = only solo tracks play and export; false takes it off.

source_in_sec.description: place: the in point in the file (default 0).

source_out_sec.description: place: the out point in the file (overrides duration_sec).

start_sec.description: trim: the new start on the timeline.

stroke.description: text: { on, color, thickness } an outline.

tag.description: clip_settings: the label colour from the clip menu: magenta, teal, mustard, blue, orange, violet, green, coral, or none.

template.description: caption: the caption template as the Captions menu names it.

text.description: text / text_edit: the words on screen.

text_id.description: text_edit / text_delete: the text layer id (read_editor_timeline lists textLayers).

to_index.description: lane_reorder: the row from the top (0 = first).

to_lane.description: move: another track of the same kind.

to_sec.description: move: the new start on the timeline.

transition.description: transition: the outgoing transition as the menu names it: None (hard cut), Cross fade, Dissolve, Wipe left, Wipe right, Wipe up, Wipe down, Slide left, Slide right, Circle open; with duration_sec 0.1 to 2.

width_pct.description: text: the box width as a percent of the frame (default 40).

x.description: text: centre across the frame, 0 (left) to 100 (right), default 50. logo: offset, default 0. clip_settings on a second-track video: the player puts its centre at 72 + x/10 percent (x -220, y 220, scale 294 = full frame).

y.description: text: centre down the frame, 0 (top) to 100 (bottom), default 50. logo: offset, default -92 (top).

name: edit_editor_timeline
title: Edit Editor Timeline
